response.rationale: The national split is not materially overstated. “Biaya sekolah” is an established Indonesian expression for school costs or fees, while “yuran sekolah” is an established Malaysian Malay expression for school fees. Indonesian also has the accepted everyday equivalent “uang sekolah,” but that variation does not invalidate the selected answer. The forms are not false friends; their meanings substantially overlap as ordinary equivalents, so an explicit false-friend contrast is unnecessary.
